responsibility: This file implements the NDS32 backend’s operation-cost model for RTL expansion and optimization. It provides the TARGET_RTX_COSTS and TARGET_ADDRESS_COST logic that scores arithmetic, loads/stores, constants, shifts, compares, and addressing forms differently for speed-focused versus size-focused compilation, with special handling for 16-bit encodings, DSP-related idioms, post-increment addressing, and the fwprop pass. In effect it is the target’s quantitative policy layer that tells generic RTL optimizers which NDS32 instruction shapes are cheap or expensive.
